statusRules.PASS: Kullanıcı test edilen kapsamda beklenen sonucu bildirdi.

statusRules.BLOCKED: Test yapılamıyor; engel kaydedilir. Test edilmemiş olması PASS değildir.

coverage.historyPolicy: Sonraki kayıtlar eski bulguları geçersiz kılar. Eski talent/Evolution/profile/Elite/custom-Boss-phase kabul maddeleri güncel teste dönüştürülmez. Önceki kullanıcı PASS kayıtları korunur.
coverage.limitations: Static/source review placeholders are not independently asked as gameplay tests. Matrix test rows represent scenario sets; only reported player count, difficulty, client and build coverage may be closed. Detailed source notes must be read before each question. No standalone engine-test-gaps file is tracked; engine gaps are in dossiers, audit snapshots and QA contracts.
coverage.scope: Tracked and untracked readable files in docs/tests/tools/game/content, excluding dependencies, binary resources, translations and historical reference archives.
